Changes: selected optical marker/joint-angle channels; five-frame smoothing; anatomical-rest-frame and marker-path-length normalization; three complete repetition crops per trial; temporal resampling and quantization. No source EMG or AMG signal is used to drive the game muscle colours.

angleDefinition: Source marker-defined flexion/ankle angles, not clinical JCS or full IK
positionUnits: dimensionless per-source initial ASIS-knee-ankle marker-path length proxy
directionUnits: unit vector in the derived right/up/forward anatomical rest frame

filter.sampling: 121 inclusive points linearly interpolated by actual source time, not frame/90
filter.rawRestSeam: retained, no raw endpoint matching or loop fabrication
filter.effortTiming: Explicit derivative: subtract linear endpoint baseline; normalize to captured excursion; monotonic cumulative halves. Raw profile channels retain observed endpoints.

sources.sourceLoad: Raised box containing two packs of 500 A4 sheets; source reports no mass in kg. Not barbell or dumbbell capture.
sources.sourceUnit: source motion-capture coordinate unit; metric scale unspecified

coordinateFrame.legProxyDefinition: mean initial ASIS-to-knee plus knee-to-ankle marker-path length; not anatomical femur/tibia lengths
